questions.question: Why did Paul not want to take Mark on his trip after he and Barnabas disagreed?

answers.text: Mark wanted to stay in Antioch

questions.question: After Paul and Barnabas parted company, Barnabas took Mark and sailed to which island?
In a vision at Troas, a man of Macedonia pleaded with Paul. What did he ask Paul to do?

answers.text: Pray for their king from Troas

questions.question: After Paul saw the vision of a man of Macedonia, what did his team conclude about going there?

answers.text: God had called them to preach there
The church in Troas had sent them
